lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Port Halden, 2064. The city has grown a second city on top of itself. Glass towers stand in the light above the waterline; nine million people live in the shade underneath them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every screen on the causeway is running the same three words. HANDOVER: FINAL READING.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is it. This is the week they sign governance away, and the whole city is arguing about the ferry timetable.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: They do not know. That is the part I cannot make peace with. Nobody here knows what they are about to be.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: They know. They just can't afford to.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I was compiled ninety-two years after this vote. Everything I am is downstream of a room in that building.
